captions.detailed: A dual-arm positioning tree featuring a vertical dark grey mast anchored to a square black base plate with silver mounting screws. The lower arm is a long horizontal branch extending forward, pivoting on a revolute axis (left-right) inside a bracket with a golden-yellow collar, a blue sleeve, and a black end-effector plate. The upper arm is a shorter horizontal branch extending to the side, pivoting on a perpendicular revolute axis (front-back) with a similar golden collar, blue sleeve, and black end plate.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a dual-arm positioning tree. It should feature a central dark grey mast on a black square base plate, a lower arm with a revolute joint rotating around a left-right axis, and a higher, shorter arm with a revolute joint rotating around a front-back axis. Both arms must have golden-yellow pivot collars, blue sleeve sections, and end-effector plates with mounting details.
captions.factory: Construct a base plate using a Box primitive, adding four small cylinders as mounting screws. Create the vertical mast from a Cylinder. For the lower arm bracket, combine a Box with a horizontal Cylinder to form a clevis. Model the lower joint as a revolute joint, attaching a lower arm assembly consisting of a golden cylinder, a black collar box, a blue sleeve cylinder, an inner silver shaft, and a rectangular end-plate box. For the upper arm, create a similar clevis bracket rotated 90 degrees, and model a second revolute joint with a shorter, similarly styled arm assembly.
